parted -s /dev/sdc mklabel gpt
parted -s /dev/sdc mkpart primary ext4 1 10G
mkfs.ext4 /dev/sdc1

(Selections: mklabel → gpt; mkpart → primary/ext4//dev/sdc; mkfs → ext4 on /dev/sdc1)

vgcfgrestore vg01 -f /etc/lvm/archive/vg01_00002-966141411.vg

Restores the VG metadata from the LVM archive after it was lost.

lvchange -a y /dev/vg01/lv01

Reactivates the logical volume now that the VG metadata has been restored.

mount -a

Updated answer: 'mount /important_data /dev/vg01/lv01' is crossed out as incorrect in the updated deck. The correct command is 'mount -a', which mounts everything listed in /etc/fstab.

Backup:
tar -cvf /backups/application.tar -C /opt/ application

Restore:
tar -xvf /backups/application.tar -C /opt/

-cvf creates a verbose archive; -C /opt/ saves only the relative application directory avoiding absolute paths. -xvf extracts back to /opt/.

Archive tab:
tar -cvf /tmp/ann.tar -C /home ann

Extract tab:
tar -xvf /tmp/ann.tar -C /home/joe

find /var/log -type f -maxdepth 1 | grep "log.[1-6]$" > /tmp/tempfile
for filename in $(cat /tmp/tempfile)
do
  gzip $filename
done
